info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Certificates API provides access to the certificates associated with students' educational enrollments. This endpoint enables developers to retrieve detailed information about the certificates earned through various educational programs. It is particularly useful for educational institutions, administrators, and analytics platforms that need to track and verify student achievements. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently manage and display enrollment certificate data as part of their educational offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information about certificates related to specific enrollments. It is designed to assist in verifying the certification status and obtaining related documentation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding enrollment certificates. It must include the necessary data to specify which certificates are being requested.

201.description: Resource created successfully, certificate enrollment is confirmed.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesRequ.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the certificate enrollment. It is expected to be a JSON string.
